_comment: Mesh-decal and trim-sheet library v2, built by Tools/Blender/decal_library.py (skill ship-pipeline 3b3). Typed items (structural: normal/AO/roughness only, take the hull paint; info: own colour; wear: procedural, sparingly), packed at a fixed texel density. Add an item and rebuild. Units: metres, item coordinates relative to its centre, x right / y up.
